Humble.""; Relief shown pictorially.; Prime meridian: [Ferro].; Includes city views in top border: London -- Paris -- Rome -- Constantinople -- Venice -- Prague -- Amsterdam -- Lisbone.; Includes portraits of native people in left and right borders: Eng. woman, Venetian, Germane, Polonian, Hungarian, Spainyard, Fren. woman, Belgian, Bohemia wom., and Graecian.; Includes illustrations of ships and sea monsters.; Text in English on verso titled The description of Europe; pages 7-8; printer's signature D.; Two pages with vertical join.
35 x 44 centimeters on sheet 42 x 55 centimeters
